items: 測試計劃及測試報告書撰寫
key_values.label: 工作技能
key_values.text: 軟體程式設計、軟體整合測試、問題追蹤處理(Bug tracking)、軟體品質與保證、系統整合分析、測試環境建置規劃、韌體整合測試、電信設備測試、測試計劃及測試報告書撰寫、自動化軟體測試

key_values.label: 其他條件
key_values.text:
Min. Qualifications:
1. 5+ yrs working exp. in software development using Python, JavaScript/Typescript, Selenium, and Linux.
W/ Smart Manufacturing exp. is a plus.
2. Good understanding of web fundamentals and code version control.
3. Graduated from recognized universities w/ a Computer Science or related degree.
4. Ability to Speak & Write in English fluently & idiomatically (TOEIC >650 or equivalent certificate)
5. Familiar with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, etc.
AI coding tools (e.g. Gemini CLI, Antigravity, etc.)
6. Ability to communicate w/ cross-functional teams, customers and stakeholders.
Others:
1. Ability to communicate w/ cross-functional teams
in English & Chinese fluently. English reading/speaking is a MUST
2. Bilingual capability is required (Mandarin & English)
Mandarin speaking/reading is essential skill in HCLTech Taiwan
3. Must demonstrate initiative and ownership of assigned responsibilities
4. Ability to work collaboratively and openly with cross-functional Team Leaders, members and client
5. Soft Skills: Good listener, positive attitude, sense of humor, open minded, respect, patience, resolving issues, etc.
6. Exp. working in a collaborative environment and promoting a teamwork mentality
7. Patience to detail, Good analytical thinking and problem-solving skills
8. Ability to predict challenges and seek to proactively head-off obstacles
9. Can work independently (e.g. manage tasks to complete on time, etc.)
10. Can work under pressure
11. Can adapt to fast-paced environment
12. Working location: may adjust to Banqiao (Tpark 台北遠東通訊園區) per Google's request
13. Taiwan APRC is required w/ expat.
可以接受英文線上面試 w/ Live coding exercise in Python (max. 20 mins)
年薪可談
